# Breathe Easy Clinic (عيادة تنفّس بسهولة)

> Chest and lung (pulmonology) clinic in the Fifth Settlement, New Cairo, Egypt. Two assistant professors of pulmonology from the Faculty of Medicine, Ain Shams University see patients six days a week. Patients book by phone or WhatsApp.

## Doctors
- Dr. Hedya Said Mohammed (د. هدية سعيد محمد): Assistant Professor of Pulmonology, Ain Shams University; doctorate in chest diseases; senior consultant in pulmonology; consultant in bronchoscopy. Sees patients Saturday and Wednesday, 4–7 pm.
- Dr. Wael Abdel Fattah (د. وائل عبد الفتاح): Assistant Professor and Consultant in Pulmonology, Ain Shams University; doctorate in chest diseases; senior consultant in chest diseases and chest allergy for children and adults; consultant in bronchoscopy. Sees patients Sunday and Thursday 4–7 pm, Monday and Tuesday 6–8 pm.

## Services
- Chest consultations (a cough that keeps coming back, shortness of breath, chest allergy, questions about a chest scan)
- Follow-up visits
- Bronchoscopy referral consultations (with Dr. Hedya)

## Opening hours (Cairo time)
- Saturday 4–7 pm (Dr. Hedya)
- Sunday 4–7 pm (Dr. Wael)
- Monday 6–8 pm (Dr. Wael)
- Tuesday 6–8 pm (Dr. Wael)
- Wednesday 4–7 pm (Dr. Hedya)
- Thursday 4–7 pm (Dr. Wael)
- Friday: closed
The live schedule and any holiday closures are shown on the website.

## Location
THE CLINICS medical building, Clinic 311, third floor, South 90th Street, Fifth Settlement, New Cairo, Egypt. The building is behind Mahmoud El Far Supermarket.
Map: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=THE+CLINICS+South+90th+Street+Fifth+Settlement+New+Cairo
